title: The Betrayer/Quotes
summary:
"The time of my coming is almost at hand. Nothing must be allowed to stand in my way."
- The Betrayer to Rassimov, ("The Dead Magic Island")

"Rassimov. You will finish the Casterwill girl. She could be a threat to us this night!"
- The Betrayer
to Rassimov, ("Words from Eathon")

"Tonight, by my designs, the Spiral Mark shall open."
- The Betrayer to Rassimov, ("Words from Eathon")

"Nothing. Everything is going exactly as I planned. Casterwill sealed the mark so it could not be used again, even on the longest night. And when he did he sealed it with a wild blade, because it only can be wielded by the true of heart."
- The Betrayer to Sophie Casterwill, ("The Spiral Mark")

"Fear not, the Spiral Mark is my domain."
- The Betrayer to Shauna, ("The Spiral Mark")

"Yes, I have taken pains to gather all potential threats, Foundation, Casterwill, and Spiral, to this very spot."
- The Betrayer to Dante Vale, ("The Spiral Mark")

"To be certain you would stab the mark of your own free will, I have been setting these events in motion since ancient times."
- The Betrayer to Lok Lambert, ("The Spiral Mark")

"All witness the Betrayer, risen again! Who stands with me?"
- The Betrayer after rising again, ("Lok and the Betrayer")

"Hear my words my sons and daughters, hear my words my friends and enemies. I have come to herald your doom! The Blood Spiral will inherit the Earth".
- The Betrayer to The Blood Spirals, Huntik Foundation and the Casterwill family, ("Lok and the Betrayer")

"Fools! Your strongest has already been destroyed. Listen to the truth and despair. Dante Vale is no more. I can feel it. Our enemies will to fight has drained away. They cannot stand against us now!".
- The Betrayer to The Blood Spirals, Huntik Foundation and the Casterwill family, ("Lok and the Betrayer")

"Sons and daughters, deliver the invaders their doom!"
- The Betrayer to The Blood Spirals, ("Lok and the Betrayer")

"Did you really believe you could stop what I set in motion so many eons ago? Watch helplessly as I bring the Spiral Mark back to life!"
- The Betrayer to Den Fears, Zhalia Moon, Sophie Casterwill and Lok Lambert, ("Dante's Return")

"It doesn't matter how many stand before me!"
- The Betrayer to Lucas Casterwill and Sandra Lambert, ("Dante's Return")

"I cannot be stopped by something as fleeting as mortal men!"
- The Betrayer to Dante Vale, ("Dante's Return")
